summary: SLOOP Dub, a fork of the SLOOP live groovebox tuned for reggae, dub and UK bass music. It keeps SLOOP's four tracks and engines and adds a dub module, siren, tape delay and loadable riddims.
features: DUB module: bipolar filter, wet mix and a throw into the delay
Dub siren played by holding OCT+, with its own LFO shapes
Tape delay whose TIME knob bends a looping echo's pitch
Twenty-two 64-step riddims that load into the sequencer
Four-band isolator with mutes, plus per-track delay throws
SLOOP base: 12 engines, 37 kits, USB audio, TRS MIDI in and clock

headings: the dub: what this firmware adds
the dub siren — pages sir and sr2
the sequencer, the riddims, the sounds — pages rdm and prs
play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
